title: Pattern Occurrences (KMP)
statement:
Given a text string T and a pattern string P, find all starting positions (0-indexed) where P occurs in T.

Print the count of occurrences on the first line, followed by each starting index on a separate line in ascending order.

Overlapping occurrences must also be counted.
constraints:
1 <= |T| <= 10^6
1 <= |P| <= 10^4
|P| <= |T|
T and P contain only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat:
The first line contains T.
The second line contains P.
outputFormat:
The first line: count of occurrences.
The following lines: each starting index (0-indexed), one per line, in ascending order.
